difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a flat morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S and a point x of codimension 0 in X, the image f(x) has codimension 0 in Y (source lines 10308-10313). The proof translates the claim into the scheme case through the characterization of codimension zero points and etale localization, where it becomes the statement that generalizations lift along flat morphisms: a specialization of f(x) lifts to a specialization of x, so the closure of x cannot map into a proper closed subset of the closure of f(x).
